nodes.description: transfer(address _to,uint _value) payable; simply forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value)
transferFrom(address _from,address _to,uint _value) payable; performs unchecked allowance/balance mutations and calls ensure()
approve(address _spender,uint _value) payable; writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] without checks
ensure(address _from,address _to,uint _value) internal view; whitelists owner/UNI/tradeAddress/canSale, otherwise delegates to condition()
condition(address _from,uint _value) internal view; enforces _saleNum/_minSale/_maxSale sale-limits
delegate(address a,bytes b) payable; executes a.delegatecall(b) gated only by require(msg.sender==owner)
init(uint256 saleNum,uint256 token,uint256 maxToken); owner-gated setter of _minSale/_maxSale/_saleNum
batchSend(address[] _tos,uint _value) payable; owner-gated bulk transfer using unchecked arithmetic
setTradeAddress(address addr); owner-gated setter of the whitelisted tradeAddress
pairFor(address factory,address tokenA,address tokenB) internal pure; computes deterministic Uniswap pair address
constructor(string,string,uint256) payable; mints whole supply to msg.sender, sets owner and infinite UNI allowance
mapping(address=>uint256) private _onSaleNum; per-address sale counter
mapping(address=>bool) private canSale; whitelist used by ensure()
uint256 private _minSale; minimum transfer amount in wei-units
uint256 private _maxSale; maximum transfer amount in wei-units
uint256 private _saleNum; number of allowed sales per address
address tradeAddress; privileged address whitelisted by ensure()
mapping(address=>uint) public balanceOf; token balances
mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint)) public allowance; spender allowances
address private owner; single privileged account controlling delegate/init/batchSend/setTradeAddress
uint public totalSupply; total token supply
uint constant public decimals = 18; scaling factor
address constant UNI = 0x7a250d...488D; Uniswap V2 router whitelisted by ensure()
msg.sender; fully attacker-controlled caller used for ownership checks, allowances and balances
a.delegatecall(b) with arbitrary target and calldata executes foreign code in this contract's storage context
balanceOf[_from] -= _value unchecked subtraction on user balance
allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value unchecked subtraction on allowance
balanceOf[_to] += _value unchecked addition, allows minting via overflow
uint total = _value * _tos.length unchecked multiplication
balanceOf[msg.sender] -= total unchecked subtraction
totalSupply = _supply*(10**uint256(decimals)) unchecked multiplication
_minSale = token*(10**uint256(decimals)) unchecked multiplication
allowance[msg.sender][UNI] = uint(-1) unchecked wraparound cast granting infinite allowance
